cases.description: A calm Irish retirement meeting gathers small batches, applies per-person State Pension assumptions and ends only after spoken authorization and the controlled outro.

turns.label: retirement_goal
turns.say: I am 60 and I would like to retire at 65 with my wife, who is already retired.

turns.label: home_position
turns.say: We own our home, it is worth about six hundred thousand euro, and the mortgage is fully paid off.

turns.label: primary_pension
turns.say: My occupational pension is worth about four hundred thousand euro and I contribute ten thousand euro a year.

turns.label: partner_pension
turns.say: My wife's pension is worth around one hundred thousand euro and she is no longer contributing.

turns.label: cash_and_investments
turns.say: We have fifty thousand euro in cash and thirty thousand euro in stocks and shares, with no other debts.

turns.label: income_and_spending
turns.say: My salary is one hundred thousand euro and we spend roughly fifty thousand euro a year.

turns.label: state_pensions
turns.say: Please assume the full Irish State Pension for me and half of the full rate for my wife.

turns.label: spoken_confirmation
turns.say: That all sounds correct. Go ahead and generate the modules now.

expected.outro: Thanks very much for your time today. Your modules are ready, and I’m taking you to them now.
